subject.title: feat: expose rawBody on user messages in plugin hook events

question: Should plugin hooks expose literal channel `RawBody`, command-normalized clean direct-user text, or wait for a shared trusted inbound-body contract?
rationale: The branch currently chooses `CommandBody ?? RawBody ?? Body` while publishing the name `rawBody`; selecting that permanent external API meaning and its relationship to the open trusted `bareBody` design requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Expose clean direct-user text
options.body: Keep the provenance gate and practical source precedence, but rename or precisely document the field as command-normalized clean user text and fix all runtime availability comments.

options.title: Expose literal RawBody
options.body: Source only the channel `RawBody` contract and use a separate future field for command-normalized or synthesized user text.

options.title: Wait for shared inbound metadata
options.body: Pause this PR until the trusted inbound-decoration contract defines one canonical clean-input source for persisted consumers and hooks.

recommendation.title: Expose clean direct-user text
recommendation.body: Keep the provenance gate and practical source precedence, but rename or precisely document the field as command-normalized clean user text and fix all runtime availability comments.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the plugin hook event contract makes this the best available decision-routing signal.
